```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

Comparing variants in DS PBMC with DS sorted immune
```{r}
## Sorted immune cell VCF for UC7
## bcell
uc7b <- data.table::fread("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/AA_normal_blood_tumors_DS_WGS_singleCells_SteveRozen_Arnoud/TwinstrandDraft/Supplementary/Supplemental_code/sorted_immune/input_data/vcfs_bloodFractions_batch1/UC7_B-cell.1.consensus.variant-calls.vcf.gz", skip = "#CHROM") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  .[,c(1,2,4,5)]
## nkcell
uc7nk <- data.table::fread("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/AA_normal_blood_tumors_DS_WGS_singleCells_SteveRozen_Arnoud/TwinstrandDraft/Supplementary/Supplemental_code/sorted_immune/input_data/vcfs_bloodFractions_batch1/UC7_NK-cell.1.consensus.variant-calls.vcf.gz", skip = "#CHROM") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  .[,c(1,2,4,5)]
## tcell
uc7t <- data.table::fread("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/AA_normal_blood_tumors_DS_WGS_singleCells_SteveRozen_Arnoud/TwinstrandDraft/Supplementary/Supplemental_code/sorted_immune/input_data/vcfs_bloodFractions_batch1/UC7_T-cell.1.consensus.variant-calls.vcf.gz", skip = "#CHROM") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  .[,c(1,2,4,5)]

## Combine together
uc7_sorted <- rbind(uc7b, uc7nk, uc7t) %>% distinct()

## Sorted immune cell VCF for UC14
## bcell
uc14b <- data.table::fread("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/AA_normal_blood_tumors_DS_WGS_singleCells_SteveRozen_Arnoud/TwinstrandDraft/Supplementary/Supplemental_code/sorted_immune/input_data/vcfs_bloodFractions_batch1/UC14_B-cell.1.consensus.variant-calls.vcf.gz", skip = "#CHROM") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  .[,c(1,2,4,5)]
## nkcell
uc14nk <- data.table::fread("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/AA_normal_blood_tumors_DS_WGS_singleCells_SteveRozen_Arnoud/TwinstrandDraft/Supplementary/Supplemental_code/sorted_immune/input_data/vcfs_bloodFractions_batch1/UC14_NK-cell.1.consensus.variant-calls.vcf.gz", skip = "#CHROM") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  .[,c(1,2,4,5)]

## Combine together
uc14_sorted <- rbind(uc14b, uc14nk) %>% distinct()

## PBMC (unsorted DS)
ds_uc7b <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/input/UC7_Blood.vcf", skip = "#CHROM") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% .[,c(1,2,4,5)] %>% mutate(status = 1, `#CHROM` = paste0("chr", `#CHROM`))
ds_uc14b <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/input/UC14_Blood.vcf", skip = "#CHROM") %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% .[,c(1,2,4,5)] %>% mutate(status = 1, `#CHROM` = paste0("chr", `#CHROM`))

## Filtered germline vcf for duplex sequenced samples
allMuts <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/vcf_ds_cleaned.txt") %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample %in% c("UC7_Blood", "UC14_Blood")) %>%
  mutate(POS = POS + 1,
         status = 1)


ds_uc7b <- allMuts %>% dplyr::filter(sample == "UC7_Blood")
ds_uc14b <- allMuts %>% dplyr::filter(sample == "UC14_Blood")

#####################
## intext analysis ##

## How many DS unsorted mutations are found in the sorted immune cells?
## UC7
match_uc7 <- uc7_sorted %>% left_join(x = ., y = ds_uc7b, by = c("#CHROM"="CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"))
table(match_uc7$status, useNA = "always")
88 / (88+1245) * 100
## UC14
match_uc14 <- uc14_sorted %>% left_join(x = ., y = ds_uc14b, by = c("#CHROM"="CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"))
table(match_uc14$status, useNA = "always")
35 / (35+455) * 100


## How many mutations found in both PBMC and sorted immune cells are clonal (read>1)?
## UC7
clonal_uc7 <- allMuts %>% dplyr::filter(group == "UC7")
match_uc7_clonal <- clonal_uc7 %>% left_join(x = ., y = match_uc7, by = c("CHROM"="#CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"))

## In both? How many clonal?
variant_detected_in_both <- match_uc7_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(status.y == 1)
table(variant_detected_in_both$alt_depth.x>1)
34/(54+34)*100
## Exclusive to blood? How many clonal?
variant_detected_in_unsorted <- match_uc7_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(status.y))
table(variant_detected_in_unsorted$alt_depth.x>1)
13/(327+13)*100

## Create contig table for fishers test
tab <- matrix(c(54, 34,
                327,  13),
              nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
              dimnames = list(Group = c("YesSorted", "NoSorted"),
                              Clonal = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
              )
tab2 <- tab[c("NoSorted", "YesSorted"), ]
fisher.test(tab2)

## Do the same thing for UC14
clonal_uc14 <- allMuts %>% dplyr::filter(group == "UC14")
match_uc14_clonal <- clonal_uc14 %>% left_join(x = ., y = match_uc14, by = c("CHROM"="#CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"))

variant_detected_in_both <- match_uc14_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(status.y == 1)
table(variant_detected_in_both$alt_depth.x>1)
17/(18+17)*100
variant_detected_in_unsorted <- match_uc14_clonal %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(status.y))
table(variant_detected_in_unsorted$alt_depth.x>1)
9/(273+9)*100

tab <- matrix(c(18, 17,
                273,  9),
              nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
              dimnames = list(Group = c("YesSorted", "NoSorted"),
                              Clonal = c("FALSE", "TRUE"))
              )
tab2 <- tab[c("NoSorted", "YesSorted"), ]
fisher.test(tab2)
```

Plotting results from previous chunk
```{r}
## Create plot data from the computed proportions in the previous chunk
uc7.pd <- data.frame(Status = c("No", "Yes"),
                     Clonal = c(3.823529, 38.63636),
                     NonClonal = c(100-3.823529, 100-38.63636),
                     group = "UC7")

uc14.pd <- data.frame(Status = c("No", "Yes"),
                     Clonal = c(3.191489, 48.57143),
                     NonClonal = c(100-3.191489, 100-48.57143),
                     group = "UC14")

pd <- rbind(uc7.pd, uc14.pd) %>% gather(data = ., key = "type", value = "value", -Status, -group)

pd$group <- factor(x = pd$group, levels = c("UC7", "UC14"))

col_anno <- c("#FFA500", "#7F7F7F")
names(col_anno) <- c("Clonal", "NonClonal")

p2 <-ggplot(data = pd, aes(x = Status, y = value, fill = type)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_anno,
                    name = "Clonal in original (unsorted)\nDS experiment") +
  ylab("Proportion") + xlab("Variant detected in sorted\nimmune cell populations") +
  facet_grid2(. ~ group, scales = "free", space = "free",
              strip = strip_themed(
              text_x = list(
                element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 6, margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
              ))) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 5),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.line.x = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 6),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.25, "cm"),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"))
```
